Protest March in Delhi Sees Clashes, Detentions, and Injuries

A protest march organized by the CJP (Congress for Justice and Peace) towards Parliament in Delhi on the first day of the monsoon session resulted in clashes between protesters and police. Police reported that over 118 personnel were injured, with some reports mentioning top Delhi cops among them. Over 70 protesters were detained. During the confrontation, tear gas was fired, and police vehicles were reportedly damaged. The protest was related to demands concerning the NEET exam paper leak and other examination reforms.
